synthesis.headline: Management delivers strong sales volume growth, but capacity and capex promises remain unverifiable.

points.text: Management's sales volume growth expectation of 10-n/a% for FY27 is on track, supported by actual 30.7% revenue growth reported for the first 2 of 4 quarters.
Capacity expansion of 250000 units for Kharkhoda and Hansalpur and the full year capex plan of 14000 cr remain unverifiable due to no reported numbers.
Annual revenue increased to 183316.0 cr in Mar 2026, while annual operating margin % decreased to 11.7% from 13.2% in Mar 2025.
Cash from operations improved to 19100.0 cr in Mar 2026, and PAT reached 14680.0 cr with strong balance sheet equity at 109002.0 cr.

bull.text: Revenue reached 183316.0 cr in Mar 2026 alongside strong cash from operations of 19100.0 cr.
ROCE improved to 19.0% for the period ending Sep 2026 compared to 16.0% previously.

bear.text: Operating margin % dropped to 11.7% in Mar 2026 and further declined in quarterly figures for Jun 2026 and Sep 2026.
Key capacity expansion and capex targets lack verifiable reporting data to assess execution.
